name: t0msilver-skills
description: Tom Vaucourt's personal agent skills: delegating to other coding CLIs, Remote Control servers, and prose cleanup. Written here or vendored verbatim.

plugins.name: cli-delegation
plugins.description: Delegate reviewer, second-opinion, and edit-worker runs to the claude, codex, and opencode CLIs, and read-only repo exploration to fastcontext. Worktree-first edits, machine-readable capture, reviewer-after-worker.

plugins.name: vendored
plugins.description: Pristine copies of third-party skills, vendored from their upstream repositories by scripts/vendor-skills.sh. Each directory keeps its upstream LICENSE and a .vendored stamp naming the repo, path, and pinned commit; fixes go upstream, never into this repo.

plugins.name: unnarrate
plugins.description: Remove self-narrating meta-commentary from UI copy, docs, code comments, and PR text — text that describes the artifact it lives in or restates what the reader already sees. First-party companion to the vendored unslop skill: unnarrate deletes what shouldn't exist, unslop fixes how the rest sounds.

plugins.name: claude-rc-server
plugins.description: Run persistent per-repo `claude remote-control` servers under user systemd so they survive reboots and stay reachable from claude.ai/code. Setup runs via the bundled install script, not automatically.
